_: Sources under .moon-data-cache/ that tools/gen-tiles.mjs and gen-maps.mjs read, with the SHA-256 the shipped assets were cut from. gen-tiles refuses a source whose digest differs: a re-downloaded product that changed upstream would otherwise re-cut a set silently. Update a digest only together with the assets cut from it.
